complexity.correctness_reason: Once the 1000-node cap is lifted, an acyclic list with more than 1005 nodes is incorrectly reported as having a cycle.
complexity.notes: This hard-codes the statement's 1000-node cap into the algorithm, so it only works while that cap holds. A proper solution runs in O(n) time, and O(1) extra space is achievable with ||Floyd's tortoise-and-hare: advance two pointers at speeds 1 and 2 and check whether they ever meet||.
complexity.summary: Walks the list for at most 1005 steps, returning False if a null pointer is reached and True otherwise, on the reasoning that any list longer than that must contain a cycle.
